q: Bilal hasn't read ______ the book to understand the story.
justification: 'enough of' تعني 'ما يكفي من'. مع الكتاب نستخدم 'enough of the book'. 'any' لا تصلح هنا، 'as much as' للمقارنة، و'many of' للمعدود.

q: Mohammed doesn't have ______ free time.
justification: 'free time' غير معدود، لذا نستخدم 'much' في النفي. 'lots' تحتاج 'of'، و'all' لا تصلح هنا.

q: Ibrahim was born ______ Riyadh.
justification: مع المدن نستخدم 'in'. 'on' للأسطح، 'by' للوسيلة، و'at' لأماكن محددة.

q: Jamal likes ______ camping with friends.
justification: بعد 'like' يمكن استخدام المصدر مع 'to' (to go) أو الفعل مع -ing. هنا 'to go' هو الصحيح.

q: My brother and I ______ the soccer match on TV last night.
justification: 'last night' تدل على الماضي البسيط، لذا 'watched'.

q: Dana lived in Canada for many years, so she ______ cold weather.
justification: 'is used to' تعني معتادة على. 'used to' تعبر عن عادة ماضية فقط.

q: Hussain doesn't know ______ car to buy.
justification: 'which' للسؤال عن الاختيار بين أشياء محددة (أي سيارة).

q: Where did you get the money ______?
justification: 'get money from' هو التعبير الصحيح (من أين حصلت على المال).

q: If ______ snowing, we will go skiing.
justification: First Conditional: If + present simple, will + infinitive.

q: ______ is a popular hobby for many people.
justification: 'Reading' كمصدر (gerund) يعمل كفاعل للجملة.

q: If the weather _____ nice tomorrow, we will go for a picnic.
justification: First Conditional: If + present simple (is).

q: Some teachers ____ much homework.
justification: 'Some teachers' جمع، الفعل بصيغة الجمع 'give'.

q: I ____ to the mall after school.
justification: الماضي البسيط من 'go' هو 'went'.

q: Look! The boys ____ football.
justification: 'Look!' تدل على المضارع المستمر: 'are playing'.

q: He ____ before I arrived.
justification: حدث قبل وصولي في الماضي: Past Perfect 'had left'.

q: This book ____ by my father.
justification: مبني للمجهول ماضي: 'was written'.

q: My sister is ____ than me.
justification: مقارنة بين اثنين: 'younger than'.

q: She enjoys ____ in the park.
justification: بعد 'enjoy' يأتي gerund: 'running'.

q: You ____ talk loudly in the library.
justification: 'mustn't' تعبر عن المنع (ممنوع التحدث بصوت عالٍ).

q: I ____ my work yet.
justification: 'yet' مع المضارع التام المنفي: 'haven't finished'.

q: She said that she ____ tired.
justification: Reported Speech: نرجع الفعل خطوة للوراء. 'I am tired' تصبح 'she was tired'.

q: If I ____ you, I would apologize.
justification: Second Conditional: If + past simple ('were' مع جميع الضمائر).

q: If he had studied, he ____ the exam.
justification: Third Conditional: If + past perfect, would have + p.p.

q: You ____ smoke here. It's a hospital.
justification: 'mustn't' للتحريم. 'needn't' لعدم الضرورة.

q: I had my car ____ yesterday.
justification: Causative: have + شيء + p.p. 'had my car repaired'.

q: I would rather ____ at home tonight.
justification: بعد 'would rather' يأتي المصدر بدون to: 'stay'.

q: I wish I ____ more money.
justification: Wish + past simple للتمني في الحاضر (مستحيل).

q: Do you know where ____?
justification: Embedded question: الترتيب فاعل + فعل (the bank is).

q: She prefers walking ____ driving.
justification: 'prefer + gerund + to + gerund'. 'Prefer...than' غير صحيح.

q: You'd better ____ now, or you'll miss the bus.
justification: بعد 'had better' يأتي المصدر بدون to: 'leave'.

q: He denied ____ the money.
justification: بعد 'deny' يأتي gerund: 'taking'.

q: If water boils, it ____ into steam.
justification: Zero Conditional: If + present, present (حقيقة علمية).

q: The teacher asked the students ____ quiet.
justification: بعد 'ask someone' يأتي 'to + مصدر': 'to be quiet'.

q: She is not ____ to drive yet.
justification: 'enough' تأتي بعد الصفة: 'old enough'.

q: Neither Ali nor Sami ____ here.
justification: مع 'neither...nor' الفعل يتبع الفاعل الأقرب (Sami مفرد): 'is'.
